headline: Parsvnath Developers Limited: Appointment of Resolution Professional under Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process
sum: Parsvnath Developers Limited notified NSE of the appointment of a Resolution Professional, marking entry into the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the Insolvency and Bankruptcy Code, 2016.
detail: Parsvnath Developers, a prominent Delhi-NCR real-estate company, has entered formal insolvency resolution following the appointment of a Resolution Professional. The RP appointment, disclosed via NSE intimation on 17 June 2026, signals admission of an insolvency petition—typically filed by a financial creditor, operational creditor, or the corporate debtor itself. Under IBC 2016, the RP assumes control of the company and must commence the 180-day (extendable to 270 days) resolution period. The announcement implies potential exposure to homebuyers, institutional lenders, and operational creditors across the group's real-estate portfolio.
